mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM volt_wechat_member w INNER JOIN volt_member m ON m.member_id = w.member_id WHERE w.openid = #{openid} ORDER BY w.active DESC, w.created_at, m.member_id
SELECT member_id FROM volt_wechat_member WHERE openid = #{openid} AND active = 1 ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
SELECT openid FROM volt_wechat_member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY active DESC, created_at LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volt_wechat_member WHERE openid = #{openid} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO volt_wechat_member (openid, member_id, active, created_at) VALUES (#{openid}, #{memberId}, #{active}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE volt_wechat_member SET active = 0 WHERE openid = #{openid}
UPDATE volt_wechat_member SET active = 1 WHERE openid = #{openid} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM volt_wechat_member WHERE openid = #{openid} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volt_member (member_id, member_no, nickname, phone, phone_bound, avatar_url, openid, unionid, goal, height_cm, weight_kg, credits, credits_total, plan_code, plan_name, expires_at, tier, referral_code, joined_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{memberNo}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{phoneBound}, #{avatarUrl}, #{openid}, #{unionid}, #{goal}, #{heightCm}, #{weightKg}, #{credits}, #{creditsTotal}, #{planCode}, #{planName}, #{expiresAt}, #{tier}, #{referralCode}, #{joinedAt})
INSERT INTO volt_token (token, member_id, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{token}, #{memberId}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO volt_otp (phone, code, purpose, expires_at, consumed, created_at) VALUES (#{phone}, #{code}, #{purpose}, #{expiresAt}, #{consumed}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE volt_otp SET consumed = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed = 0
UPDATE volt_otp SET consumed = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE volt_otp SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
